Therefore CIN/LLPIN, PAN (and its 4th-character holder type), GSTIN, GST status, incorporation date, registered-office state and MCA status are all null — NOT confirmed absent, simply not retrieved. Role left as 'unknown': the name and declared HS codes (732690 / 847790 / 848071 — steel articles, rubber/plastics machinery parts, injection-mould tooling) are consistent with a tool-and-die / mould maker, but no registry record (MCA main-object clause, NIC code) was read to confirm manufacturer vs trader, so no role is asserted. No state was claimed in the input, so state_registered vs state_claimed cannot be compared. Per project rules the company is NOT rejected: there is no evidence of non-existence, strike-off, liquidation or bankruptcy — the absence of data is a research limitation, not a negative finding. Recommend re-running with a working search backend or MCA/GST portal access before any verdict; status should be treated as 'unverified, pending registry check'.
